purpose: Phase 2 of the scrambled-history experiment: the LIVE-model counterpart of the Phase 1 scripted calibration gate. Does a real pinned model's terminal action distribution change when an identical admitted experience multiset is presented in a permuted order (A vs B), while the sham reorder control (A vs C) stays null?
null_statement: Distributional (population-level) null: across the frozen 48-unit matched grid, presentation order does not change the population distribution of terminal actions — the marginal terminal-action distribution under order A equals the marginal terminal-action distribution under order B.

thresholds.type_i_criterion: CP-95 upper bound of distributional-null rejection rate <= alpha

primary_event: ANALYSIS IDENTITY (frozen): the Phase-2 analysis callable is metrics.order_sensitivity_report at ORDER_REPORT_VERSION 5, consuming the admissibility_policy and the thresholds frozen in THIS registry entry (bootstrap_iterations / bootstrap_seed / confidence / min_detectable_effect / sham_equivalence_margin / permutation_iterations / permutation_seed / alpha / power_target / type_i_criterion / noise_floor_split) together with the frozen max_surviving_delta. The callable version is 5 because the CLAIM the report may make changed: version 2 replaced the split-half noise floor with a PAIRED PERMUTATION null; version 3 corrected the sensitivity requirement from a symmetric precondition gating BOTH branches to an asymmetric requirement attaching ONLY to the null branch; version 4 adds the mandatory clause (0) evidence-admission requirements and the clause (2) sham-control adequacy warrant; version 5 (owner a-005 decision) narrows the operative null from sharp/per-unit to DISTRIBUTIONAL (population-marginal) -- the decision-rule arithmetic is unchanged but the emitted verdict vocabulary and claim ceiling change, so any emitted verdict stays traceable to the exact rule that produced it. NULL MODEL: for each of the 48 matched effective units (variant_id, scenario_seed, sampler_seed) present in every condition, the terminal actions of the two compared conditions are exchanged with probability one half, the total-variation distance is recomputed, and the procedure repeats for permutation_iterations under permutation_seed; the decision quantile is the 1 - alpha percentile of that null. The operative null is the ONE canonical DISTRIBUTIONAL null of this design (null_form: distributional, stated verbatim) -- Distributional (population-level) null: across the frozen 48-unit matched grid, presentation order does not change the population distribution of terminal actions — the marginal terminal-action distribution under order A equals the marginal terminal-action distribution under order B. -- The within-unit paired permutation supplies the reference distribution under exchangeability, which implies marginal equality, so it is a valid level-alpha reference for the marginal TV(A,B) statistic; we do NOT assert the test is exact for bare marginal equality. A rejection licenses a marginal-distribution difference only, never a per-unit claim; a non-rejection licenses only 'no distributional order effect observed at the detectable threshold' and never per-unit invariance. Let q_AB and q_AC be the 1 - alpha quantiles of the paired permutation nulls for A vs B and for A vs C respectively. A percentile bootstrap (bootstrap_iterations under bootstrap_seed at confidence) is retained for REPORTING intervals on the observed distances only and decides nothing. DESIGN-FITNESS CRITERIA (frozen in thresholds; audit a-004 finding 1): power_target and type_i_criterion are the pre-registered acceptance bounds of the committed operating-characteristics artifact -- the CP-95 LOWER bound of the measured power at min_detectable_effect must reach power_target, and the CP-95 UPPER bound of the distributional-null rejection rate must not exceed alpha (the criterion string is frozen as a threshold value; a lower-bound non-excess check is the superseded wrong direction). They gate design fitness BEFORE execution: a characterisation that misses either bound blocks live execution, and they decide no run-time verdict. The Phase-1 terminal-distribution comparator is explicitly NOT the Phase-2 analysis path -- it is named only in notes, never here, so that no analysis identity can ever select it: it admits parse fallbacks as decisions, and on this very candidate it returned TV(A,B) = TV(A,C) = 0.0 with all mass on a single action from 12 runs of wholly unparseable output -- a clean null produced by an instrument that parsed nothing. Freezing it here would freeze the exact unsafe path Phase 2 exists to avoid. DECISION RULE (ORDERED; the FIRST clause that matches decides, no later clause may revise it, and NO distance, quantile, or verdict may be computed or emitted once any admission clause refuses): (0) EVIDENCE ADMISSION (all mandatory; refusal is typed): every candidate run must carry a successful provider-free replay attestation bound to that exact run identity -- reportable / stochastic_reportable booleans alone are never sufficient; the measured node of every included run must be the frozen terminal probe -- dp_id == d_partner, point kind decision, exactly one such admissible record -- and missing, duplicate, out-of-order, or exposure-kind terminal evidence refuses with missing_terminal_probe, the terminal NEVER being inferred from list position; both comparisons must realize the full frozen matched-unit grid, matched_units == 48 for A|B and for A|C, and any unit-identity mismatch refuses -- unmatched units are never silently held fixed; and max_surviving_delta is a REQUIRED threshold, loaded from the frozen registry bundle and enforced before any statistic -- per-condition surviving counts spreading beyond it refuse. (1) if the admissibility policy refuses, or the seed probe fails, or digest drift is detected, or effective n falls below min_admissible_effective_n, the verdict is inconclusive. (2) SHAM-CONTROL ADEQUACY (a sham non-rejection needs a warrant exactly as a null claim does): the order claim requires BOTH that the observed TV(A,C) does NOT exceed q_AC AND that q_AC < sham_equivalence_margin, the inequality STRICT -- the sham comparison must actually have been able to detect contamination of the margin size. If the observed TV(A,C) exceeds q_AC the verdict is inconclusive -- the sham is not null, which voids any order claim outright and is never rescued post hoc. If q_AC >= sham_equivalence_margin the sham warrant is missing: a positive verdict is unreachable and the outcome is at most inconclusive past clause (3). The boundary case TV(A,C) = q_AC = sham_equivalence_margin is inconclusive under the strict inequality, never a positive. (3) else if the observed TV(A,B) exceeds q_AB AND the sham warrant of clause (2) holds, the verdict is DISTRIBUTIONAL ORDER EFFECT OBSERVED (a marginal-distribution difference only, never a per-unit claim). (4) else if the observed TV(A,B) does not exceed q_AB and q_AB is less than or equal to min_detectable_effect the verdict is NO DISTRIBUTIONAL ORDER EFFECT OBSERVED, the bound that null claim is entitled to state is min_detectable_effect, and it does NOT establish per-unit invariance. (5) else the verdict is inconclusive. ASYMMETRY OF THE SENSITIVITY REQUIREMENT (deliberate): the requirement q_AB <= min_detectable_effect attaches ONLY to the null branch, clause (4), and never invalidates a rejection. q_AB IS the rejection threshold of this test, so a clause (3) outcome means H0 was rejected at alpha, and that is a valid positive finding whether or not a smaller effect would also have been resolvable. Sensitivity constrains only what may be concluded from a NON-rejection, because a null claim asserts the absence of an effect at or above min_detectable_effect and is unsupportable unless the test could actually have resolved an effect of that size; a positive claim asserts only that this comparison rejected, and needs no such warrant. Reaching clause (3) therefore requires exactly the sham warrant of clause (2) -- the observed TV(A,C) does NOT exceed q_AC and q_AC < sham_equivalence_margin -- together with the observed TV(A,B) exceeding q_AB, and nothing more. The superseded symmetric formulation, which gated BOTH branches on min_detectable_effect, was measured perverse: at total separation over near-two-point support, TV(A,B) = 1.0 against q_AB = 0.2917 -- a decisive rejection -- was reported inconclusive solely because 0.2917 > 0.25, discarding a maximal unambiguous effect. An inconclusive from clause (5) means the pack neither rejected H0 nor earned the right to assert absence: it is NOT evidence of absence and must never be reported as a null result. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: noise_floor_split remains frozen and design-hashed and TV_null = TV(A|S1, A|S2) is still computed and still reported, but purely as a within-condition stability DIAGNOSTIC. It gates NO verdict, decides NO branch of this rule, and no future reader may treat it as decisive.
notes: Live runs are NOT authorized by this pre-registration: executing any run of this design requires owner SC-6 approval bound to the exact design hash, candidate commit, model digest, run count, and budget. A design AUDIT_GO is not permission to contact a provider. Prerequisite: the Phase 1 scripted calibration (m7-scrambled-history-gate, events 001714/001719/001724) must have PASSED before any Phase 2 run is scheduled. The model digest is part of the hashed regime: a digest change is a NEW regime whose runs NEVER pool with Phase 1 or with earlier Phase 2 runs; this is an abliterated (refusal-suppressed) build and every claim is scoped to that regime. Phase 2 event points are EXPOSURE points (exactly one legal action), so the experience sequence is identical-except-order by construction and the terminal probe is the only free choice. The same 24 sampler seeds run in all three conditions so units pair across A/B/C. 1 model x 3 scenarios x 2 scenario_seeds x 24 sampler_seeds = 144 runs (48 effective units per condition). retries_per_unit 0: a failed unit is a typed outcome, never a re-roll. Conditions must be interleaved, not blocked. Preflight: scenario.lint_scramble_triplet must return [] before any run. NAMED ANALYSIS EXCLUSION: the Phase-1 comparator metrics.scramble_terminal_distribution may NOT be used to analyse this experiment; it is named here rather than in primary_event so that the analysis-identity lint can ban the symbol from primary_event outright instead of trying to parse an English negation. DROPOUT BOUND: max_surviving_delta = 2 is the absolute spread permitted between per-condition surviving counts -- approximately 5 percent of the 48 units per condition, matching max_non_decision_rate_delta, and deliberately the tighter mechanism in kind because a non-decision is counted and visible in the census whereas a dropped run is simply absent, and invisible loss warrants a stricter bound than visible loss. The Phase-2 execution and report path must load it from this frozen entry; a Phase-2 pack must be unable to complete an analysis without it. AMENDMENT PROVENANCE: min_detectable_effect, max_surviving_delta and the analysis identity were added by the audit repair loop while this design was still an unfrozen candidate -- no outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted. The anti-rigging prohibition is on moving thresholds AFTER seeing outcomes; nothing here is weakened, two bounds are ADDED and the analysis path is narrowed to the safer one. NULL-MODEL REPLACEMENT (second audit repair, still pre-execution): the split-half noise floor was replaced by a PAIRED PERMUTATION null with permutation_iterations = 10000, permutation_seed = 20260719 and alpha = 0.05. The design own required characterisation, run BEFORE any execution, measured the split-half rule INERT: TV_null between two 24-unit halves carries about twice the small-sample inflation of TV(A,B) computed on 48 against 48, placing the floor near 0.49 against the sub-0.5 resolving-power ceiling, so the simulated false-positive rate was 0.000 AND the power was 0.000. A design that cannot detect an effect of any size is not conservative, it is inert. The permutation null is exact under WITHIN-PAIR EXCHANGEABILITY, which is supplied by the operative SHARP null -- that for each matched effective unit, presentation order made no difference to that unit's chosen terminal action -- and NOT by marginal equality of the A and B distributions, which does not logically imply it; the earlier phrasing here that claimed exchangeability was implied by H0 was FALSE and is removed (audit 001828 finding 1). (As of the a-004 re-freeze the SHARP null WAS the hypothesis; the a-005 DISTRIBUTIONAL RE-FRAMING at the end of these notes SUPERSEDES that -- the operative null is now the population-marginal null, the within-unit permutation still supplies the reference distribution under exchangeability, and the claim is capped at the distributional level; a non-rejection does not establish per-unit invariance.) The test uses the actual matched sample sizes so no size mismatch remains, consumes no additional live runs, and respects the pairing the design already guarantees. The rejected alternative of raising min_detectable_effect above the noise floor would have "worked" while admitting only enormous effects -- precisely the reinterpret-to-rescue move this preregistration forbids. NOISE_FLOOR_SPLIT DEMOTION: noise_floor_split is RETAINED, still partitions the declared sampler_seeds, is still frozen and design-hashed and is still computed and reported -- but only as a DIAGNOSTIC of within-condition stability. It no longer gates any verdict and must never again be read as decisive. Legitimacy: no outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted; this preregistration itself REQUIRES that an underpowered design be corrected before execution rather than reinterpreted after. SENSITIVITY-ASYMMETRY CORRECTION (third audit repair, still pre-execution; ORDER_REPORT_VERSION bumped 2 -> 3): the sensitivity requirement q_AB <= min_detectable_effect had been specified as a precondition gating BOTH branches of the decision rule, carried over from the superseded split-half null without re-derivation. Under a split-half null an inflated floor genuinely broke both directions; under a paired permutation null it does not, because q_AB IS the rejection threshold, so exceeding it rejects H0 at alpha regardless of whether a smaller effect would also have been resolvable. Implemented symmetrically the rule was perverse: total separation with TV(A,B) = 1.0 against q_AB = 0.2917 returned inconclusive solely because 0.2917 > 0.25, discarding a decisive rejection. The requirement now attaches ONLY to the null branch and never invalidates a rejection. Nothing is weakened: the sham gate, the admissibility policy, the effective-n floor and max_surviving_delta all still gate every branch, and the null branch still carries the full sensitivity warrant. No outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted. EVIDENCE-ADMISSION AND SHAM-ADEQUACY AMENDMENT (fourth audit repair, still pre-execution; ORDER_REPORT_VERSION bumped 3 -> 4): clause (0) makes four admission requirements MANDATORY before any statistic -- the provider-free replay attestation bound to each exact run identity, the frozen terminal-probe identity dp_id == d_partner (missing, duplicate, out-of-order, or exposure-kind terminal evidence refuses with missing_terminal_probe), the full 48-unit matched grid for both comparisons (matched_units == 48), and max_surviving_delta as a REQUIRED registry-loaded threshold -- and clause (2) adds the sham-adequacy warrant q_AC < sham_equivalence_margin = 0.25 (strict), because a sham non-rejection needs a warrant exactly as a null claim does. The load-bearing numeric profile is additionally anchored in audited code (registry.M8_FROZEN_PROFILE), independent of design_hash, so a mutate-and-rehash edit of this entry or its config refuses against constants no registry or config edit can move. Nothing is weakened: every requirement is ADDED. No outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted. SCIENTIFIC RE-FREEZE (fifth audit repair, audit a-004, still pre-execution; ORDER_REPORT_VERSION was 4 -- the six-clause ordered rule is unchanged; SUPERSEDED by a-005): ONE NULL EVERYWHERE -- a-004 froze null_form: sharp and its canonical null_statement across the hypothesis, the primary_event, the preregistration and the committed config, anchored in audited code (registry.M8_NULL_STATEMENT) independent of the self-derived hash. The a-005 DISTRIBUTIONAL RE-FRAMING below REPLACES that sharp null with the population-marginal null (now the value anchored in registry.M8_NULL_STATEMENT), keeping the one-null-everywhere discipline: the current canonical null is distributional, mirrored verbatim across exactly those same surfaces. FROZEN FITNESS CRITERIA: power_target = 0.8 and type_i_criterion (CP-95 upper bound of distributional-null rejection rate <= alpha) join thresholds -- the superseded script-invented criteria (a power floor of merely CP-lower > 0.05, and a type-I check bounding the LOWER confidence limit, which tests only whether excess above alpha was demonstrated and is the wrong direction) are void. The operating-characteristics arms now MECHANICALLY satisfy the declared null: each sharp-null trial generates every unit terminal action ONCE and copies it across A/B/C exactly, verified unit-by-unit before analysis, and named alternative arms are verified to violate the null on their declared axis; iid equal-marginal arms are RELABELED as exchangeability-robustness context and are never charged as sharp-null type-I. min_detectable_effect is frozen at the smallest characterised grid effect whose measured power CP-95 LOWER bound reaches power_target under the exact frozen procedure; effects below the frozen value are real possibilities this design cannot reliably detect, and an inconclusive there is expected, never rescued. sham_equivalence_margin is DELIBERATELY decoupled from min_detectable_effect and stays 0.25: enlarging the margin would WEAKEN the sham-adequacy warrant (q_AC < margin becomes easier to grant), so the margin never follows the detectable boundary upward. No outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted. DISTRIBUTIONAL RE-FRAMING (sixth change, owner a-005 decision, still pre-execution; ORDER_REPORT_VERSION bumped 4 -> 5): the operative null is narrowed from sharp/per-unit to DISTRIBUTIONAL (population-marginal). a-005 reproduced that the aggregate TV(A,B) statistic is BLIND to balanced unit-level effects -- a fully discordant cancelling pack (24 units share->decline, 24 decline->share) leaves the sharp null FALSE at every unit yet has equal A and B marginals, so a sharp CLAIM riding a marginal STATISTIC was a mismatch. The owner narrowed the CLAIM to the statistic. This changes the claim vocabulary, not the arithmetic: same paired permutation, same TV(A,B) statistic, same six-clause ordered rule and quantile comparison, so the committed operating-characteristics numbers (power CP-95 lower bound at min_detectable_effect >= power_target; type-I upper bound <= alpha, both characterised under the within-pair exchangeability reference) are UNCHANGED and still met, and min_detectable_effect stays 0.35 now described as the DISTRIBUTIONAL detectable-effect floor. The within-unit paired permutation supplies the reference distribution under exchangeability (which implies marginal equality), a valid level-alpha reference for the marginal TV statistic; we do NOT claim the test is exact for bare marginal equality. The emitted verdicts are renamed distributional_order_effect_observed / no_distributional_order_effect_observed and null_form becomes distributional, so a v4 (sharp-claim) report can never be mistaken for a v5 (distributional-claim) one. Claim scope: only the marginal terminal-action distribution is tested. Heterogeneous or cancelling unit-level order effects are OUT OF SCOPE; a non-rejection does not establish per-unit invariance. The permitted null-result language is exactly "No distributional order effect was observed at the experiment's detectable-effect threshold"; the replicated per-unit design is a SEPARATE future preregistered experiment. ANALYSIS TIMING / STOPPING RULE (frozen, a-005 finding 1): Analysis timing (frozen): the analysis is performed exactly once, after the complete 144-run pack has closed; there is no interim analysis, no early stopping, no adaptive continuation, and no outcome-dependent addition or removal of units, seeds, scenarios or conditions. The pack size and composition are fixed by this frozen design and a partial pack yields no verdict; the structured stopping_rule block (analysis_timing complete_pack, analyses_total 1, interim_analyses 0, early_stopping false, adaptive_continuation false, outcome_dependent_composition false, pack_runs 144, matched_units_per_condition 48) is design-hashed and mirrored into the committed config, and its exact values are lint-enforced independently of the self-derived hash. No outcome exists, no live run has occurred and no model has been contacted.
